personal direction by Sisi is not established.","limitations":["The source does not provide a complete list or case outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-62774034c1a4b315","start_unit":7,"end_unit":7,"fact_summary":"Ahmed Tantawy and 21 supporters were sentenced in 2024 for conduct associated with his peaceful 2023 presidential challenge; the court also barred Tantawy from national elections for five years.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.3","4B.8"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The challenged political activity and election occurred in 2023; sentence was imposed in 2024.","ruler_attribution":"Judicial and state conduct under Sisi's government; the source does not prove Sisi personally ordered the prosecution.","limitations":["The source characterizes the ruling as based on peaceful political activism but does not provide the full judgment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-62774034c1a4b315","start_unit":7,"end_unit":8,"fact_summary":"Egypt's economic approach prioritized large infrastructure projects, including military-led projects, while recurring crises brought high commodity prices, rising poverty, reduced food and electricity access, and inadequate social-protection, health, and education spending.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.6","5B.8","5B.9","5B.10","6B.1","6B.2","6B.6","6B.10","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Primarily describes 2024, with policy continuity from the Sisi period; use for 2023 only as contextual evidence.","ruler_attribution":"Government policy under Sisi; causal attribution to Sisi personally is not separately demonstrated.","limitations":["Most quantitative observations are for 2024 or earlier; the source does not isolate 2023 outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e560fa4c69b24ca1","start_unit":5,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"In a September 2023 speech, Sisi stated that he launched the National Dialogue and directed the government to study its first outcomes, develop implementation mechanisms, and begin activating them.","question_ids":["4B.1","4B.2","4B.10","8B.1","8B.2","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated September 16, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Direct statement and directive by Sisi.","limitations":["The speech records announced directives, not verified implementation or independent assessment."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e560fa4c69b24ca1","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Sisi announced September 2023 measures including doubling the exceptional cost-of-living allowance to 600 Egyptian pounds, raising the minimum wage for specified sixth-grade employees to 4,000 pounds, raising the tax-exemption threshold from 36,000 to 45,000 pounds, increasing Takaful and Karama payments by 15% for 5 million families, and doubling an exceptional grant to 600 pounds for 11 million citizens.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.8","5B.9","6B.1","6B.2","6B.3","6B.6","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated September 16, 2023; the record is an announcement rather than an execution result.","ruler_attribution":"Measures were personally announced and directed by Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not verify funding, implementation, uptake, or real purchasing-power effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e560fa4c69b24ca1","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Sisi directed the Agricultural Bank of Egypt to launch debt-relief measures for indebted small farmers and ordered exemption of certain unpaid interest and late-payment fines owed to the General Authority for Reconstruction Projects and Agricultural Development through the end of 2024.","question_ids":["5B.8","5B.9","6B.3","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Directly dated September 16, 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Measures were personally ordered by Sisi.","limitations":["The source does not report implementation, beneficiary numbers, or fiscal effects."]},{"source_id":"SRC-d97e06e86fd72564","start_unit":9,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"Egypt had signed the Comprehensive Nuclear-Test-Ban Treaty on October 14, 1996 but had not ratified it as of the displayed status record.","question_ids":["1B.4"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"The status page is current and records a pre-2023 signature; it does not establish a 2023 decision by Sisi.","ruler_attribution":"State-level treaty status; no personal attribution to Sisi is established.","limitations":["The page does not provide the date of the latest Egyptian decision or explain the non-ratification."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e57a27546c88ffd4","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"A US indictment alleged that five unnamed Egyptian government officials, including military and intelligence figures, participated in a bribery scheme involving Senator Robert Menendez and his associates to advance Egyptian government interests; the defendants denied the charges.","question_ids":["7B.3","7B.4","7B.6","7B.9","7B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Indictment reported September 25, 2023, concerning conduct spanning earlier years.","ruler_attribution":"Allegations concern unnamed Egyptian officials and do not establish Sisi's personal knowledge, direction, or benefit.","limitations":["These are allegations in an indictment, not adjudicated findings; the Egyptian officials are unnamed."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e57a27546c88ffd4","start_unit":4,"end_unit":5,"fact_summary":"The Egyptian Agriculture Ministry allegedly made IS EG Halal the exclusive certifier for US halal beef imports in 2019, later extended exclusive rights to South America; certification fees rose and the US Foreign Agricultural Service estimated American beef liver prices increased by about 13 Egyptian pounds per kilogram.","question_ids":["5B.4","5B.5","7B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The event occurred in 2019 and is reported in 2023; it is background evidence rather than a 2023 event.","ruler_attribution":"The allegation concerns the Agriculture Ministry and linked security-connected entities; no personal attribution to Sisi is established.","limitations":["The source reports investigative findings and indictment allegations, not a final court determination."]},{"source_id":"SRC-47c67c6f8de1516d","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"In August 2023, North Sinai residents staged a sit-in demanding return to lands from which they had been forcibly displaced; after a commander promised return by October, authorities did not fulfill the promise, and the army dispersed a subsequent October 23 protest, arrested demonstrators, and conducted home raids.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.8","3B.9","4B.3","4B.10","8B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Directly concerns August and October 2023.","ruler_attribution":"Conduct by military authorities under Sisi's government; personal authorization by Sisi is not established.","limitations":["The source is a rights-organization statement and includes eyewitness-based allegations."]},{"source_id":"SRC-47c67c6f8de1516d","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"North Sinai residents remained displaced after military operations; the statement estimates approximately 150,000 people were displaced and says authorities had taken no serious steps to ensure return or provide fair compensation, despite Sisi's April 2022 declaration that military operations had ended.","question_ids":["3B.7","3B.9","4B.10","6B.3","6B.6","6B.10","8B.7","8B.10"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The displacement began before 2023, while the failure to secure return is reported as continuing through the 2023 events.","ruler_attribution":"Sisi's declaration is directly attributed; continuing implementation failures are attributed to Egyptian authorities.","limitations":["The displacement estimate is from the statement and is not independently quantified here."]},{"source_id":"SRC-47c67c6f8de1516d","start_unit":6,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"Rights organizations reported that the army used excessive force, including live ammunition, arbitrary arrests, and physical assaults against North Sinai residents protesting for return.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.8","3B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Reported in connection with the October 2023 protest.","ruler_attribution":"Allegations concern army personnel under Sisi's government; personal direction by Sisi is not established.","limitations":["The report relies on eyewitness accounts and advocacy documentation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0db8b1aa8170ff6a","start_unit":14,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"The IMF's US$3 billion, 46-month loan program published in January 2023 included expansion of Takaful and Karama to 5 million households and a nominal increase in the social-spending floor to 153 billion Egyptian pounds, but depreciation and inflation were reported to erase much of the increase; food prices had risen 37% year-on-year by October and the pound had depreciated about 50% since February 2022.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","5B.8","5B.9","6B.2","6B.5","6B.6","6B.10","8B.6","8B.7"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Directly concerns the 2023 IMF program and conditions reported in January 2023, with some indicators from 2022.","ruler_attribution":"Government policy and IMF conditionality under Sisi; the source does not isolate presidential decisions.","limitations":["The source is an advocacy analysis and does not verify full implementation by year-end 2023."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0db8b1aa8170ff6a","start_unit":18,"end_unit":18,"fact_summary":"The IMF program required publication of state-owned-enterprise financial accounts and public procurement contracts above 20 million pounds, including military-owned companies, but Egypt had previously excluded military businesses from reporting and produced flawed procurement disclosures.","question_ids":["5B.5","5B.7","7B.6","7B.7","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"Program commitments were reported in January 2023; the documented reporting failures predated or accompanied the program.","ruler_attribution":"Government commitments and reporting under Sisi's administration; personal presidential direction is not established.","limitations":["The source does not establish whether the 2023 disclosure requirements were fully implemented."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-31b0b9da920656bf","SRC-f7fa1663c254c92d","SRC-2d4d0643c8c25c0f","SRC-40f428e5df6586b8","SRC-a8a6c3ef888487e7"],"batch_limitations":["Several supplied documents concern periods other than 2023 or provide general institutional background rather than ruler-specific facts for 2023.","No score is assigned."]}
